method: Prefix scan with selected-only guaranteed checks
preconditions: A complete fixed strict ranking containing every source unit exactly once
Source units map modeled identifiers to the compiled lifecycle index
Fallback eligibility is fixed across worlds
Query bounds and k satisfy the source-time contract
outputs: Exact context stability under the declared model

complexity.query: O(j) for j examined ranked candidates
complexity.storage: O(k) for selected output and frontier

novelty: Implementation of the established context criterion; no separate novelty claim.
